claim_boundary: DIRAC-015 completes the conditional free-Dirac continuum derivation. DIRAC-016 proves scoped cube-copy exchange. DIRAC-017 proves the conditional cubical spin-one-half representation and continuous-angle Hamiltonian covariance only in the stated derived sector. DIRAC-018 gives a scoped local factorization classification and does not classify arbitrary nonlocal or flavor-mixing roots. DIRAC-019/020 prove finite spectral and coherent spatial transport, but not a uniform fixed-physical-time convergence rate. DIRAC-021 derives the action-selected rest phases and native frequency 19; a pure branch's global phase is not claimed to be an observable clock. DIRAC-022 uses the already-derived Hamiltonian momentum-response velocity and a normalized coherent positive/negative rest-branch superposition to prove the free-continuum velocity expectation c_eff cos(2 chi0 t), angular frequency 38, position amplitude sqrt(12)/38, and peak-to-peak excursion sqrt(12)/19. Pure branches, same-sign branches and incoherent mixtures have zero signal. The chain does not establish a localized nonlinear native electron trajectory, an SI frequency or length, electromagnetic coupling or g-factor, unrestricted live-chi localized electron transport, electron identity or formation, or canonical LFM status.
